source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Treasure Locations (Quick Hand's Request)
source_excerpt:
You first encounter Quick Hand Zhang in Phantom Blade Zero after the bridge to Pangzhen collapses, forcing you to take the long route through Crimson Forest. After freeing him from his cell, Zhang mentions that you can find him in a cave up ahead, and you also receive the Quick Hand's Request tale. This quest requires you to find treasures scattered across Crimson Forest and return them to Zhang.
Quick Hand's Request continues through a large portion of the game , with Zhang appearing in several regions to ask you to retrieve more treasures in exchange for rewards. The guide below covers the location of every treasure you need to find to complete his questline.
All Crimson Forest Quick Hand Zhang Treasure Locations
Sect Leader's Snuff Bottle: Use the Crimson Forest Crank near the Outlaw Trap Bell and head down. Descend the ladder, then turn right and take the upper path leading to a green chest containing the item.
Bloodstained Seal: From the Thieves' Camp Bell, follow the main path until you reach a cave with an enemy that rings a bell and summons dogs. You can find the second treasure in the same room.
Ancient Crossbow: Open the chest inside Thieves' Camp Dungeon , which is accessible with a key.
Reward : Flying Dagger (Phantom Edge)
All Village of Lu Quick Hand Zhang Treasure Locations
Wedding Candles: From the Well of the Three Puppets Bell, head left and continue straight until you enter a building with a powerful Puppet inside. Defeat it and climb the ladder to reach a room full of Puppets staring at you. The chest is at the end of the room on the left.
Unveiled Statue: From the Lady Grounds Bell, head towards the harmless Puppets staring at you and climb up the nearby path. Follow it to reach the green chest.
White Jade Twins: Next to the Survivors' Courtyard Bell, look for a rope leading down into a small cave containing the green chest.
All Pangzhen Quick Hand Zhang Treasure Locations
Tiger Paperweight: Find this inside Tianxiang Pavilion . You can obtain the key to the building while completing the Star Performer quest.
Ink Stick: After defeating Wu Xuan, continue straight and head up the stairs. You will find several Puppets and a house containing the chest.
Carved-edge Inkstone: After taking the zipline down from the Narrow Alley Residence 2nd Floor, enter the house on your left. You can find the treasure alongside a Memory Flower.
Jade Brush Rest: Use You Loong's Deluge on the fire south of the Marketplace Bell, then climb up the rooftops.
All Meigu Lake Quick Hand Zhang Treasure Locations
Blue Blossom Compass: Find this at the far east corner of the Blackwater Crew Dock.
Blight Astrolabe: Search inside the Phantom Illusionist Ruins to find this treasure.
Sundial of Impermanence: Continue exploring the Phantom Illusionist Ruins until you reach the area after the fifth Bell to find this treasure.
Reward : Sha-Chi Blood Catalyst (Medicine)
All Mirage Estate (Pangzhen) Quick Hand Zhang Treasure Locations
General's Bronze Mirror: After the Yuding, No.12 boss fight, continue forward until you reach an area with more enemies. Defeat them and enter the building on the right to find the treasure in one of its rooms.
Gold-And-Silver Sachet: Use the Opera Ticket to enter the Opera House, then look inside to find this treasure.
Golden Cloud-Moon Hairpin: Defeat the enemies in the area after Leng Tu's Study Bell. You can find the treasure in a chest nearby.
Reward : Thundermoon Lantern (Accessory)
